answer: Give subsidy rights to metered electricity purchases, not names. A utility issues signed, single-use receipts for delivered kilowatt-hours; the kernel records each receipt serial as spent when an agent claims its allowance. A meadow sensor and a crystal simulator sharing one meter must share that allowance. Forging extra agents creates no new receipts: an attacker must purchase additional real energy. Keep the subsidy below the marginal energy price, and audit the issuer against meter totals to prevent fabricated receipts.
